def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    """Volatge-Dependency Product (VDP) for OTFT devices."""
    
    Kp = parameters[0]  # Subthreshold Slope
    Kg = parameters[1]  # Channel parameter
    Kd = parameters[2]  # Factor related to output conductance, even for saturation region
    Vth = parameters[3]  # Threshold voltage
    Lambda = parameters[4]  # Lambda factor
    Phi = parameters[5]  # Surface potential
    Tau = parameters[6]  # Channel length modulation parameter
    Ts = parameters[7]  # Channel length saturation voltage
    
    gamma = parameters[8]  # Channel length modulation factor
    Vgs_ons = parameters[9]  # Gate voltage for onset of saturation region
    Vds_ons = parameters[10]  # Drain voltage for onset of saturation region
    V1 = parameters[11]  # Factor for pressure and temperature effects
    
    log10_current = np.zeros_like(gate_voltage_abs)
    
    for i in range(gate_voltage_abs.shape[0]):
        if gate_voltage_abs[i] < Vth:
            # Sub-threshold region
            log10_current[i] = parameters[0] + parameters[1] * gate_voltage_abs[i] + \
                               parameters[2]
